epidemic.zh: 流行病、（傳染病的）大流行

ex.en: Thousands upon thousands have died from the epidemic.
ex.zh: 成千上萬的人死於這場傳染病。

ex.en: Health officials are working to stop the epidemic.
ex.zh: 衛生官員正努力遏止疫情。

epidemic.en: a sudden spread of a disease to many people

ex.en: Obesity has become an epidemic in many countries.
ex.zh: 肥胖已經成為許多國家普遍的問題。

ex.en: There is an epidemic of fake news online.
ex.zh: 網路上假新聞氾濫。

epidemic.en: a very fast increase in a bad problem

ex.en: She has a degree in epidemiology.
ex.zh: 她擁有流行病學學位。

ex.en: Epidemiology helps us understand how diseases spread.
ex.zh: 流行病學幫助我們了解疾病如何傳播。

epidemiology.en: the study of how diseases spread and can be controlled

ex.en: I've only seen the first episode.
ex.zh: 我只看過第一集。

ex.en: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
ex.zh: 說真的，第 21 集讓我笑到差點哭出來。

ex.en: That reminds me of a Spongebob episode.
ex.zh: 這讓我想起一集《海綿寶寶》。

episode.en: one part of a TV series

ex.en: It was a painful episode in her life.
ex.zh: 那是她人生中一段痛苦的經歷。

ex.en: He doesn't like to talk about that episode.
ex.zh: 他不喜歡談那件事。

episode.en: one event or period in a person's life

ex.en: The church is governed under an episcopal system with bishops.
ex.zh: 這間教會採用由主教管理的主教制。

ex.en: He attended an Episcopal church every Sunday.
ex.zh: 他每個星期天都去聖公會教堂。

ex.en: The Odyssey is a famous epic from ancient Greece.
ex.zh: 《奧德賽》是古希臘著名的史詩。

ex.en: She is writing an epic about her family's long journey.
ex.zh: 她正在寫一部關於她家族長途旅程的史詩作品。

ex.en: They began an epic journey across the desert.
ex.zh: 他們展開了橫越沙漠的史詩般旅程。

ex.en: The movie ends with an epic battle on the mountain.
ex.zh: 這部電影以山上一場壯闊的戰役作結。

ex.en: That concert last night was epic!
ex.zh: 昨晚的演唱會超讚的！

ex.en: He pulled off an epic goal in the last minute.
ex.zh: 他在最後一分鐘踢進一個超神的進球。

ex.en: This small cafe epitomizes the charm of the old town.
ex.zh: 這間小咖啡館是老城區魅力的縮影。

ex.en: She epitomizes kindness and hard work.
ex.zh: 她是善良與勤奮的典範。

ex.en: He had an epiphany while walking in the park and decided to change careers.
ex.zh: 他在公園散步時突然頓悟，決定換工作。

ex.en: The scientist's epiphany came in the middle of a quiet night.
ex.zh: 科學家的靈感是在一個寧靜的夜晚突然出現的。

ex.en: Epiphany is celebrated on the sixth of January in many countries.
ex.zh: 許多國家在一月六日慶祝主顯節。

ex.en: The church held a special service for Epiphany.
ex.zh: 教堂為主顯節舉行了一場特別的禮拜。

ex.en: The invention of the printing press marked a new epoch in history.
ex.zh: 印刷術的發明開創了歷史上的新紀元。

ex.en: We are living in a new epoch of digital communication.
ex.zh: 我們正處於數位通訊的新時代。

ex.en: The epithelium forms the outer layer of the skin.
ex.zh: 上皮組織構成皮膚的最外層。

ex.en: A thin layer of epithelium lines the inside of the stomach.
ex.zh: 胃的內側襯著一層薄薄的上皮組織。

ex.en: The course covers epistemological questions such as how we know what is true.
ex.zh: 這門課探討認識論問題，例如我們如何知道什麼是真的。

ex.en: She wrote a paper on the epistemological limits of science.
ex.zh: 她寫了一篇關於科學在認識論上的限制的論文。

ex.en: Fame can be ephemeral, lasting only a few months.
ex.zh: 名氣可能很短暫，只維持幾個月。

ex.en: The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.
ex.zh: 櫻花的美是短暫的。

ex.en: She is the epitome of kindness.
ex.zh: 她是善良的最佳典範。

ex.en: The house was the epitome of good taste.
ex.zh: 那間房子是好品味的縮影。

ex.en: The king was given the epithet 'the Wise' by his people.
ex.zh: 人民給那位國王取了「智者」的稱號。

ex.en: Her cheerful nature earned her the epithet 'Sunny'.
ex.zh: 她開朗的個性為她贏得了「小太陽」的綽號。

ex.en: This small cafe epitomises the charm of the old town.
ex.zh: 這家小咖啡館體現了老城區的魅力。

ex.en: Her kindness epitomises the spirit of our team.
ex.zh: 她的善良正是我們團隊精神的縮影。

ex.en: An epidemiologist studies how diseases spread in a population.
ex.zh: 流行病學家研究疾病如何在人群中傳播。

ex.en: The epidemiologist explained the data to reporters.
ex.zh: 那位流行病學家向記者解釋了這些數據。

ex.en: She has had epilepsy since she was a child.
ex.zh: 她從小就有癲癇。

ex.en: Medicine can help control epilepsy in many patients.
ex.zh: 藥物可以幫助許多患者控制癲癇。

epsom.zh: 艾普森（英國薩里郡的城鎮）

ex.en: Epsom is a town in Surrey, England.
ex.zh: 艾普森是英國薩里郡的一座城鎮。

ex.en: The famous horse race called the Derby is held at Epsom.
ex.zh: 著名的德比賽馬在艾普森舉行。

ex.en: The team published an epidemiological study of the disease.
ex.zh: 研究團隊發表了這種疾病的流行病學研究。

ex.en: Epidemiological data helped officials plan the response.
ex.zh: 流行病學的數據協助官員規劃因應措施。

ex.en: Epistemology is the part of philosophy that asks how we know things.
ex.zh: 知識論是哲學中探討「我們如何知道事物」的一門領域。

ex.en: The student wrote a paper on epistemology for her philosophy class.
ex.zh: 這名學生為哲學課寫了一篇關於知識論的報告。

ex.en: The epicenter of the earthquake was deep under the sea.
ex.zh: 這次地震的震央在深海底下。

ex.en: Buildings near the epicenter suffered the most damage.
ex.zh: 靠近震央的建築物受損最嚴重。

ex.en: The city became the epicenter of the protest movement.
ex.zh: 這座城市成了抗議運動的中心。

ex.en: The small town was the epicenter of the outbreak.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮是疫情爆發的中心。

ex.en: The floor was covered with a shiny epoxy coating.
ex.zh: 地板上塗了一層亮亮的環氧樹脂塗層。

ex.en: He fixed the broken cup with epoxy glue.
ex.zh: 他用環氧樹脂膠修好了破掉的杯子。

ex.en: His headaches are episodic, so he only takes medicine when one starts.
ex.zh: 他的頭痛是斷斷續續的，所以只有發作時才吃藥。

ex.en: The country's episodic rainfall makes farming difficult.
ex.zh: 這個國家的降雨時有時無，讓農耕很困難。

ex.en: The novel has an episodic structure, with each chapter telling a separate story.
ex.zh: 這本小說採片段式結構，每一章都是獨立的故事。

ex.en: I prefer episodic shows because I can watch one episode at a time.
ex.zh: 我比較喜歡分集的影集，因為一次可以只看一集。

ex.en: The epitaph on his gravestone was short and simple.
ex.zh: 他墓碑上的墓誌銘簡短又樸素。

ex.en: She asked that a line from her favorite poem be used as her epitaph.
ex.zh: 她要求用她最喜歡的詩中的一句話當作墓誌銘。
